jobs.title: Product-demo clips for shops
jobs.sample_offer: Three demo clips using approved product footage
jobs.hook_a_en: This shop needs a demo, not hype.
jobs.hook_b_en: Can your video answer one buying question?
jobs.hook_a_ar: المحل محتاج شرح، مش كلام كبير.
jobs.hook_b_ar: الفيديو بيجاوب سؤال العميل ولا لأ؟
body_en: Pick a product you own or have permission to film. Show what it does, one important detail, and who it is for.

jobs.sample_offer: Ten-minute problem conversation, not a sales ambush
jobs.hook_a_en: Ask this before you build anything.
jobs.hook_b_en: Would they pay, or are they being polite?
jobs.hook_a_ar: اسأل ده قبل ما تبدأ تبني.
body_en: Don't start with: do you like my idea? Ask when this problem last happened and what they did about it.
